extracted.name: Easy Herb Rice
extracted.description: In this easy herb rice recipe, dress up your rice with various herbs, onion, and broth for a side dish, an addition to stir-fries, or for fried rice.
instruction_lines: Combine water, onion, bouillon, thyme, marjoram, and rosemary in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
